{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace Contract

inductive Op where
  | begin
  | get
  | set
  | delete
  | commit
  | abort
  | unknown

def opFromStr (s : String) : Op :=
  if s = "begin" then Op.begin
  else if s = "get" then Op.get
  else if s = "set" then Op.set
  else if s = "delete" then Op.delete
  else if s = "commit" then Op.commit
  else if s = "abort" then Op.abort
  else Op.unknown

inductive Result where
  | ok : Result
  | exists : Result
  | unknown : Result
  | null : Result
  | val (n : Nat) : Result
  | committed (v : Nat) : Result
  | conflict (keys : List String) : Result

structure State where
  values : List (String × Nat)
  versions : List (String × Nat)
  globalVersion : Nat
  activeTx : List (String × List (String × Nat) × List (String × Nat))

def initState (initial : List (String × Nat)) : State :=
  { values := initial,
    versions := initial.map (fun p => (p.1, 0)),
    globalVersion := 0,
    activeTx := [] }

def getValue (s : State) (k : String) : Option Nat :=
  List.findMap? s.values (fun p => if p.1 = k then some p.2 else none)

def getVersion (s : State) (k : String) : Nat :=
  match List.find? s.versions (fun p => p.1 = k) with
  | some p => p.2
  | none => 0
  end

def getTx (s : State) (tx : String) : Option (List (String × Nat) × List (String × Nat)) :=
  List.findMap? s.activeTx (fun p => if p.1 = tx then some (p.2.1, p.2.2) else none)

def addTx (s : State) (tx : String) (readSet : List (String × Nat)) (writeSet : List (String × Nat)) : State :=
  { s with activeTx := (tx, (readSet, writeSet)) :: s.activeTx }

def removeTx (s : State) (tx : String) : State :=
  { s with activeTx := s.activeTx.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ tx) }

def updateTx (s : State) (tx : String) (readSet : List (String × Nat)) (writeSet : List (String × Nat)) : State :=
  { s with activeTx := s.activeTx.map (fun p => if p.1 = tx then (tx, (readSet, writeSet)) else p) }

def applyWrites (s : State) (writes : List (String × Nat)) (v : Nat) : State :=
  let newValues := s.values.filter (fun p => ¬ List.mem? (fun w => w.1 = p.1) writes)
  let newVersions := s.versions.filter (fun p => ¬ List.mem? (fun w => w.1 = p.1) writes)
  { values := newValues ++ writes.map (fun w => (w.1, w.2)),
    versions := newVersions ++ writes.map (fun w => (w.1, v)),
    globalVersion := v,
    activeTx := s.activeTx }

def processEvent (s : State) (tx : String) (op : Op) (key : String) (val : Nat) : State × Result :=
  match op with
  | Op.begin =>
    match getTx s tx with
    | some _ => (s, Result.exists)
    | none =>
      let snapVals := s.values
      let snapVers := s.versions.map (fun p => (p.1, getVersion s p.1))
      (addTx s tx snapVals [], Result.ok)
  | Op.get =>
    match getTx s tx with
    | some (rs, ws) =>
      match List.find? ws (fun p => p.1 = key) with
      | some p => (updateTx s tx (key :: rs) ws, Result.val p.2)
      | none =>
        match List.find? rs (fun p => p.1 = key) with
        | some p => (updateTx s tx (key :: rs) ws, Result.val p.2)
        | none => (updateTx s tx (key :: rs) ws, Result.null)
    | none => (s, Result.unknown)
  | Op.set =>
    match getTx s tx with
    | some (rs, ws) =>
      let newWs := (key, val) :: ws.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ key)
      (updateTx s tx rs newWs, Result.ok)
    | none => (s, Result.unknown)
  | Op.delete =>
    match getTx s tx with
    | some (rs, ws) =>
      let newWs := (key, 0) :: ws.filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ key)
      (updateTx s tx rs newWs, Result.ok)
    | none => (s, Result.unknown)
  | Op.commit =>
    match getTx s tx with
    | some (rs, ws) =>
      let conflicts := (rs.map (·.1) ++ ws.map (·.1)).filter (fun k => getVersion s k ≠ (match List.find? rs (fun p => p.1 = k) with | some p => p.2 | none => 0))
      let sortedConflicts := conflicts.toSet.toList.sort
      if sortedConflicts.isEmpty then
        if ws.isEmpty then
          (removeTx s tx, Result.committed s.globalVersion)
        else
          let newV := s.globalVersion + 1
          (applyWrites (removeTx s tx) ws newV, Result.committed newV)
      else
        (removeTx s tx, Result.conflict sortedConflicts)
    | none => (s, Result.unknown)
  | Op.abort =>
    (removeTx s tx, Result.ok)
  | Op.unknown =>
    (s, Result.unknown)

def solve (initial : List (String × Nat)) (events : List (String × Op × String × Nat)) : State × List Result :=
  let s0 := initState initial
  let (sFinal, results) := events.foldl (fun acc ev =>
    let (s', r) := processEvent acc.1 ev.1 ev.2 ev.3 ev.4
    (s', acc.2 ++ [r])) (s0, [])
  (sFinal, results)

def validInput (initial : List (String × Nat)) (events : List (String × Op × String × Nat)) : Prop :=
  True

def validSuccessCase : Prop :=
  ∃ (initial : List (String × Nat)) (events : List (String × Op × String × Nat)),
    validInput initial events ∧
    (match solve initial events with
    | (s, results) => results.length = events.length)

def validErrorCase : Prop :=
  ∃ (initial : List (String × Nat)) (events : List (String × Op × String × Nat)),
    validInput initial events ∧
    (match solve initial events with
    | (s, results) => ∃ r ∈ results, r = Result.unknown)

theorem non_vacuity : validSuccessCase ∧ validErrorCase := by sorry

end Contract",

   "bindings":[{"obligation":"D1","declarations":["Contract.Op","Contract.Result","Contract.State","Contract.solve"]},
               {"obligation":"A1","predicate":"Contract.validInput"},
               {"obligation":"O1","theorem":"Contract.non_vacuity"},
               {"obligation":"N1"}],
   "internal_obligations":[{"id":"W1","kind":"non_vacuity","theorem":"Contract.non_vacuity","witnesses_for":["A1"],
       "description":"valid success and error cases exist"}]}}
